{{Current events|year=2019|month=06|day=23|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Yemeni Civil War (2015–present)]]
**[[Houthi insurgency in Yemen|Houthis]] launch a [[drone strike]] that kills a [[Syria]]n and wounds 21 more. The attack takes place at the [[Abha International Airport]], which [[Abha International Airport attack|was attacked]] two weeks ago with a [[Ballistic missile|ballistic missile]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yemen-security/yemens-houthis-hit-saudi-airport-killing-one-expat-saudi-led-coalition-says-idUSKCN1TO0SH (Reuters)]
**There are unconfirmed reports of another attack at the [[Jizan Regional Airport|Jizan Airport]], although there has been no confirmation. [https://www.businessinsider.com/houthi-attack-abha-airport-saudi-arabia-2019-6 (Business Insider)]
**[[Houthi insurgency in Yemen|Houthis]] warn of worse attacks if [[Saudi Arabia]] continues its escalation and aggression in [[Yemen]]. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2019-06/24/c_138167351.htm (Xinhua)]
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**Twenty-six [[Boko Haram]] militants and 11 [[Chad|Chadian]] soldiers are killed in an ambush after the soldiers recover cattle that the militants had seized. Nine [[Chad|Chadian]] soldiers are injured. [https://www.yahoo.com/news/boko-haram-jihadist-attack-kills-8-chad-sources-131016511.html (Yahoo News)]
*[[Internal conflict in Myanmar]]
**Twenty [[Myanmar Army|Myanmar soldiers]] and two [[Arakan Army (Kachin State)|Arakan Army]] insurgents are killed in clashes in [[Mrauk-U Township]], [[Rakhine State]]. [https://www.rfa.org/english/news/myanmar/fighting-in-myanmars-rakhine-state-06242019161628.html (''Radio Free Asia'')]

;Arts and culture
*[[Persecution of homosexuals in Nazi Germany]]
**A ceremony is held at the former site of Germany’s [[Buchenwald concentration camp]] to remember people imprisoned there because they were thought to be gay. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2019/06/24/world/social-issues-world/nazi-branded-gay-prisoners-remembered-buchenwald-camp-site/#.XRAUbuhKjcc (Japan Times)]

;International relations
*[[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis]]
**[[President of Chile|Chilean President]] [[Sebastián Piñera]] says he agrees with [[President of Argentina|Argentine President]] [[Mauricio Macri]] that the "corrupt dictatorship of [[Nicolás Maduro|Maduro]] has its days numbered". [https://www.abc.es/internacional/abci-sebastian-pinera-dictadura-corrupta-maduro-tiene-dias-contados-201906222104_noticia.html (ABC ES)]
*[[Venezuelan refugee crisis]]
**[[Chile]] is extending its offer of "democratic responsibility" visas, allowing Venezuelans to live in the country for up to two years, so that they may be applied for from any Chilean embassy or consulate in the world instead of just in Venezuela. However, Chile border control now also demands visas upon entry for Venezuelans, a tightening of the previous 90-day free period. The move should aid Venezuelans trying to travel through other Latin American nations that have changing restrictions. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-chile-venezuela-immigration/chile-offers-democratic-responsibility-visa-to-venezuelan-migrants-idUSKCN1TN0MN (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*[[June 2019 Istanbul mayoral election]]<!-- news refers to both, link to DAB recommended -->
**The re-run Istanbul mayoral election concludes with a victory for opposition leader [[Ekrem İmamoğlu]] and defeat for the ruling [[Justice and Development Party (Turkey)|AK Party]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-48739256 (BBC)]
*[[2019 in the Czech Republic]]
**Hundreds of thousands take to the streets of [[Prague]] to demand the resignation of Czech Prime Minister [[Andrej Babiš]] in the country's biggest protest since the [[Velvet Revolution]] in 1989. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-48737467 (BBC)] [https://edition.cnn.com/2019/06/23/europe/czech-republic-babis-protest-intl/index.html (CNN)]
